title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・我が心、盛大に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Sakura Chiyono O runs, she can feel her old self breaking apart. However, she continues running forwards alongside her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leaves the scattered pieces of her past self behind and is reborn as a new racer, embracing what she possesses in the here and now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky showers praise on her, both for winning the race and for overcoming her trial.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon, the two will face off as rivals at the Japan Cup to fulfill their promise.
